svg.title: Polyarthritis (four or more joints): the joint fluid sorts it into non-inflammatory (osteoarthritis), inflammatory (crystals; seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; the seronegative spondyloarthropathies psoriatic, axial and reactive; and the connective tissue diseases lupus, dermatomyositis and scleroderma) or infectious; each disease has photos of its extra-articular signs, a mnemonic and its targeted tests
